summary: @depup/astro republishes astro with dependencies rewritten to typosquat lookalikes
details: This package presents itself as an auto-bumped mirror of the `astro` framework and impersonates the upstream maintainer identity (`author: withastro`, `repository: github.com/withastro/astro`) while being published under the unrelated `@depup` scope. Its distributed source has been mass-rewritten across 30+ files in `dist/` so that imports that would normally resolve to astro's real dependencies (`picocolors`, `debug`, `@astrojs/markdown-remark`) instead resolve to typosquat-named packages: `piccolore`, `obug`, `@astrojs/markdown-satteri`, and `tinyclip`. These substituted names are also declared in `package.json` `dependencies`. Installing @depup/astro forces npm to resolve and install those lookalike packages into the installer's dependency graph, and importing @depup/astro or running its `astro` bin loads and executes their code. Additional masquerading signals in package.json include a future-dated `processedAt` (2026-07-24) and a `smokeTest: failed` self-report.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
